mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_outbox ( order_id, type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE order_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND type = #{type}
UPDATE order_outbox SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND type = #{type} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND retry_count < 5 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
